note: XXVII cue 98: Mina's forehead clear — the same close-up with the mark and smoke removed

beats.text: Remove the mark from the young woman's forehead completely and remove all the smoke, so her forehead is perfectly clear, smooth and unmarked skin lit by the rosy sunset, and the sky above her is clean. Keep her face, expression, hair, scarf, light and background exactly as they are.
